text:
sara: Heads up — eu-west-3 p2 fleet showing sustained egress bursts from tenant `vectrix`. Other tenants seeing 95th latency spikes + packet drops.

josh: Seen the alert. can you paste the grafana query you ran?

sara: `rate(egress_bytes_total{pool="p2-eu-west-3"}[1m])` + per-tenant grouping. here's a quick excerpt from topk:
```
vectrix: 320MB/s
analytics: 18MB/s
preview: 12MB/s
```

mohit: Oof. Is this noisy neighbor or an actual upload job? Any correlation with scheduled jobs?

sara: Not cron-y. Timeline shows spike after 09:12 UTC, sustained. flows show many small connections (chatty).

renee: Could be model sharded uploads + KV sync. If vectrix keeps pushing KV cache bulks, egress will blow. Two options: soft carveout or egress shaping.

ida: Soft carveout timeline + cost? If we carve 1/4 of p2 fleet for vectrix for 2 hours, estimate cost delta ~ +18% for that AZ's reserved billing because of rebalancing.

mohit: Can we try routing constraint first? e.g., apply tenant egress policer to limit vectrix to 250MB/s burstable and see if tail improves. Lower cost hit.

sara: Agree. quick experiment plan:
1) Apply egress policer rule -> 250MB/s burst, 100MB/s steady.
2) Observe 5m/1h latency / packet-drop.
3) If still bad, carveout 1/4 pool for 2h and re-eval.

josh: How do we push the policer? snippet below.
```yaml
policer:
  tenant: vectrix
  pool: p2-eu-west-3
  steady: 100MB/s
  burst: 250MB/s
  mode: policing
```

ops-bot: policer apply accepted -> job id=policer-az-eu3-313 (will propagate in ~20s).

monitoring-bot: alert update: egress_saturation@90% -> suppressed for vectrix (policy applied). continuing to monitor.

renee: If policer stabilizes tail but causes queuing for vectrix, we might need a dedicated slice (reserved). If we reserve, we should use preemptible carveouts first to lower cost. Request: do not do full reserved until we have telemetry for 24h.

mohit: Agreed. also add KV-cache eviction tuning for vectrix model updates — ask their infra if they can back off retention windows during the event.

ida: I'll ping their AE/SE. @vectrix_contact?

sara: thanks. I'll watch the dashboard and post quick wins. If policer doesn't drop 95th within 15m, I'll trigger the carveout playbook (owner: sara).

josh: add a quick smoke check command for ops to run: `curl -H "x-tenant:vectrix" https://p2-eu-west-3.health/probe` to validate egress path.

ida: noted. tagging this as action: `policer-applied`, owner: sara, followup: 2h.

ops-bot: policer propagation complete.

sara: Initial 5m looks better, 95th latency down ~40%. leaving in place, will reopen if things regress.

mohit: good. if we see recurrence, schedule a 30m pathing window to simulate heavier internal loads and confirm dedicated slice sizing.

renee: Thanks team. summary: applied tenant egress policer -> improvement. next steps: contact vectrix for KV tuning, monitor 2h, fallback to soft carveout if needed.
